title: Research organisation to declared domain (conceptual relationship bundle)
identifier_representations: From roles: ROR ID, schema domains
reason:
Direction m1-ror → m1-domain. Expected cardinality: organisation may declare several domains; reverse uniqueness must be measured. Unresolved compatibility, no universal organisational identity claim.

Phase 2 context reviewed: bundle; directly attached assertion dispositions are enumerated in p2-coverage.json. Member/dependency IDs preserved. Each unresolved/rejected mapping, source rights and temporal/domain gap remains a readiness prerequisite; no portfolio selection or executable bundle acceptance. Conceptual relationship retained as related-distinct, not equivalence or physical FK. Source-specific cardinality/crosswalk still required.
practical_value: ROR schema offers publisher-asserted domain associations, stronger than inferring organisation from arbitrary website URL. Exact current schema, record version and association quality still need dataset verification.
